purpose: Freeze the observable boundary for the qualitative government-securities supply-pressure node without relabelling raw issuance volume, auction demand, or secondary-market liquidity as a single causal pressure variable.

official_source_family.institution: Romanian Ministry of Finance — General Directorate of Treasury and Public Debt

example_reviewed_source.title: Public debt report — February 2025
example_reviewed_source.section: III. Primary and secondary market of government securities
example_reviewed_source.published_bid_to_cover_definition: amount of bids submitted / accepted amounts

related_market_capacity_fields: outstanding government securities issued on domestic market
holdings of government securities issued on domestic market
official_source_family.published_liquidity_ratio_definition: total volume of monthly secondary-market transactions / total volume of government securities

auction_rule_evidence.source: Ministry of Finance Order 1068/2021 English publication governing government-securities auction terms
auction_rule_evidence.relevant_rule: The Ministry may increase, decrease or cancel the amount borrowed depending on financing needs and/or the yield resulting after an auction; auction results are made public.

candidate_observable_vector.why_preferred_over_accepted_amount: The announced amount precedes auction allocation, while accepted amount may respond to bids, financing needs and the yield outcome.

candidate_observable_vector.interpretation_guard: This is an auction demand-coverage measure, not supply pressure itself.
Published bid-to-cover uses accepted amount in the denominator. Because accepted amount is partly an auction outcome, this metric cannot be promoted as a pure ex-ante supply-pressure measure.
Liquidity is market context/capacity evidence and is not synonymous with primary-market supply pressure.

maturity_and_currency_boundary.reason: The Ministry bid-to-cover chart is explicitly for government securities issued on the internal market denominated in RON; mixing RON and EUR auction pressure without a preregistered conversion/market-depth rule is prohibited.
maturity_and_currency_boundary.maturity_composition_role: candidate stratification/control; not collapsed into one duration-weighted pressure index at this stage

prohibited_shortcuts: Use raw BNR gross issuance volume as government_securities_supply_pressure.
Use accepted auction amount as a pure ex-ante supply measure.
Use inverse published bid-to-cover as the supply-pressure node without separately retaining announced, submitted and accepted amounts.
Treat secondary-market liquidity as primary-market supply pressure.
Combine RON and EUR issuance or yields into one scalar without a preregistered boundary.
Infer a causal supply-to-yield coefficient from contemporaneous 2025 descriptive observations.

materialisation_gate.reason: The official source boundary and definitions are identifiable, but the reviewed Ministry PDF is currently exposed principally as graphical PDF output and exact raw-source retention/extraction has not yet passed repository provenance checks.
required_before_any_candidate_series_is_: Retain the exact Ministry monthly public-debt-report PDF vintage with SHA-256 and source URL.
Verify whether announced, submitted and accepted monthly RON amounts can be extracted exactly from the retained source rather than visually approximated from chart geometry.
Retain the exact denominator source/vintage for outstanding domestic RON government securities.
Preserve published bid-to-cover values as a diagnostic and independently recompute submitted/accepted where exact amounts permit.
Preserve secondary-market liquidity as a separate context series if materialised.
Freeze lag convention before computing announced_amount / outstanding_stock.
